mechanism: New home sales are signed before construction starts, so rising sales point to more building, hiring and household spending ahead; a pro-cyclical reading is bullish for equities.
key_finding: As known at the time (real-time HSN1F vintages), the rule selected on in-sample data uses zscore_60m at L12 (IS Sharpe 0.91) with held-out OOS Sharpe 0.65 versus buy-and-hold 1.00.
caveats: New home sales are revised heavily in the following months; the headline uses the values as published at each date (ALFRED vintages) and the as-revised-today result is shown for comparison only.
The strategy is search-selected and needs fresh holdout validation.
The earlier research run's rule (20261015, branch spike261015_is_oos_floor, never on main) was the single highest in-sample Sharpe on revised data with fixed lags; it is replaced here.
narrative_summary: New home sales are tested as an early housing-cycle signal for SPY allocation.
